source: TSTD, comprehensive mung bean cultivation manual, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Mung bean], 2013
text: The manual closes with a cost-benefit economic analysis table itemizing production costs (seed, fertilizer, labor by operation, pest/disease control) against expected revenue at typical yield and farm-gate price levels, giving farmers a template for estimating expected profitability of mung bean production under recommended practice versus their own current practice.
